question: In coastal areas, during the night, wind blows from land to sea because:

options.text: low pressure is created on land
high pressure is created at sea

solution:
The correct answer is __**water cools slower than land**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A sea breeze is any wind that blows from a large body of water toward or onto a landmasses
 
• Sea breezes occur during hot, summer days because of the unequal heating rates of land and water.
 
• During the day, the land surface heats up faster than the water surface hence creating a high temperature and low-pressure zone on land.
